created_at.description: The datetime when this experiment was created.

layer.description: Experiments that share a layer are mutually exclusive: each claims a disjoint allocation of the layer's 100 slots. Rename the layer to reshuffle every experiment in it.

unit.description: Context fields that identify the subject being assigned, e.g. ["run_id"] or ["organization_id", "pr_id"]. Every experiment in a layer must declare the same unit.

enabled.description: When false, subjects in the allocation are reported as disabled and get no arm. The allocation stays reserved.

arms.description: Weighted arms. The arm is chosen by a hash that is independent of the layer slot, so changing the allocation never reshuffles arms.

start.description: First slot of the layer this experiment claims.

size.description: Number of slots claimed, i.e. the percentage of the layer. {start: 0, size: 40} covers slots 0 through 39.

name.description: Stable identifier reported in assignments and exposure records.

weight.description: Relative share of the experiment's subjects. Weights need not sum to 100. Up to 1,000,000,000.

config.description: Free-form settings the service reads when this arm is assigned.
